name: 🎯 Prescribed for you
blurb: Chosen from your own error profile — heaviest on quietMove, skewer, fork, pin. Rebuilt each Sunday.

name: ♜ Rook endgames
blurb: The most common endgame there is, and the one most often thrown away.

name: ♙ Pawn endgames
blurb: Pure calculation: opposition, breakthroughs, races. No pieces to hide behind.

name: ♝ Minor-piece endgames
blurb: Bishop and knight endings — where the wrong trade decides the game.

name: ♔ Mating nets
blurb: Forced mates in 2 to 4. Calculate to the end before you commit.

name: 🧠 Quiet moves & zugzwang
blurb: No check, no capture — the hardest kind of move to see. Directly on your leak.

name: 🛡 Defensive resources
blurb: You're under fire and there is exactly one move that holds. Find it.

name: 🎣 Deflection & decoy
blurb: Remove, overload or lure the defender. The tactics you miss most after forks.

name: 💥 Discovered attacks
blurb: Move one piece, unleash another. Easy to miss from both sides.

name: 📌 Pins & skewers
blurb: Line pieces doing two jobs at once.

name: 🍴 Forks & double attacks
blurb: Two threats, one move — the most common way material actually changes hands.

name: ⚔ Attacking the king
blurb: Sustained attacks and breakthroughs against a king.
